en.headline: sogeisetsu: 16 commits, 3 issue actions on openchamber #4537
en.summary: On 2026-10-08 the user logged **16 commits** across two repositories, with no pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` there were 14 own commits plus 12 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`; the own work focused on the flow and watchdog docs — redrawing the push-flow diagram to include the Cloudflare Workers Builds line, restructuring two diagrams so that "no infinite loop" is expressed as visual language rather than a caption, adding a "what happens after one push to main" diagram, switching the flow diagrams to the Excalifont handwriting style (fontFamily 5 -> 1), adding an ops index, recording the Workers Builds auto-deploy config and watch-paths pitfalls, adding a watchdog run-chain Excalidraw, and extending the watchdog fallback scope to a second workflow (the 30-day activity card) with independent timelines. In `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` there were 2 own commits that split the run-flow sketch into en/zh scenes, wired the README figures, and added a bilingual hand-drawn Excalidraw sketch of the run flow.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：16 次提交，openchamber #4537 上 3 次 issue 操作
zh.summary: 2026-10-08 当天，用户共提交 **16 次**，分布在两个仓库，没有 PR、review、release 或 discussion。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中有 14 次本人提交，另有 12 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交；本人提交集中在 flow 与 watchdog 文档上——重画推送流程图并把 Cloudflare Workers Builds 那条线画进去，把两张图完全重构，让「不会无限循环」成为图形语言而不是一行小字，新增一张「往 main 推一次提交之后会发生什么」的图，把流程图字体换成 Excalifont 手写体（fontFamily 5 -> 1），新增 ops 索引，记录 Workers Builds 自动部署配置与 watch paths 踩坑，新增 watchdog 运行链路 Excalidraw 图，并把 watchdog 兜底范围扩到第二个 workflow（30 天活动卡片），两条时间线各算各的。在 `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 中有 2 次本人提交，把 run-flow 草图拆成 en/zh 场景、在 README 中接入配图，并新增一张双语手绘 Excalidraw 运行流程草图。issue 方面，用户新开了 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 #4537（"[Bug] OpenCode Go quota shows 'Provider not configured' while the Providers page shows an API key for it"），随后又在该 issue 上评论了两次，合计 3 次 issue 操作；`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复了一次，将该 issue 标记为 `fix-ready`，并确认当前 main 上两个界面解析 OpenCode Go 凭据的方式不同。
